reason: Retain the 382 measured lines as the store connection acceptance suite: baseline refusal, pool configuration, shutdown state, audit handoff, and durability settings share real open/close fixtures. The change replaces production-only diagnostic-stamping and marker-classifying helpers with direct fixture seeding and raw marker reads, without adding lines. Reconsider any growth above this measured size. Health-suite additions verify cancellation cannot erase confirmed damage and completion cannot be reported when clearing the pending stamp fails. They do not expand the 382-line connection acceptance suite or change its lifecycle boundary.
